typography.instruction: Use system fonts optimized with strict tracking and lineHeight for a premium feel. Since @expo-google-fonts is not permitted, these properties will make the default system fonts look intentional and high-end.

shadows.instruction: Since Expo 54 deprecates the old shadow* props, use the modern 'boxShadow' string style. E.g., '0px 4px 12px rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.08)'

login_hero_image.description: A beautiful dog on a green field. Use this as a header banner in the login or welcome screen to evoke trust and nature.

animitra_logo_instruction.description: Construct the Animitra logo natively using React Native Vector Icons (e.g., FontAwesome5 'paw' or MaterialCommunityIcons 'leaf') and a bold Text component side-by-side. Both should be colored #2E7D32. Do not use placeholder images.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use React Native components and StyleSheet. No Tailwind CSS.
Apply the exact typography scales (fontSize, fontWeight, letterSpacing, lineHeight) using system fonts. This is critical for achieving the premium SaaS look without external fonts.
Implement 'testID' attributes (the React Native equivalent of data-testid) for all interactive and key informational elements, e.g., testID='login-button'.
CRITICAL: React Native 0.76+ (Expo 54) deprecates `shadowColor`, `shadowOffset`, etc. You MUST use `boxShadow: '0px 4px 12px rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.08)'` instead.
Replace generic black shadows with the green-tinted shadows provided in the shadows configuration. This deeply integrates the brand color into the physical depth of the app.
Use a background color of #F6FBF6 for all main screens so that cards with #FFFFFF background pop out nicely.
The 6 stat cards on the dashboard should use the 'sm' or 'md' shadow and a border-radius of 12. Generous padding (16px) is a must.
Modals and Bottom Sheets (like Quick Add) should use the 'lg' border-radius (20px) on the top-left and top-right corners.
